mechanism.symptom: After branch 1 completed its round-1 entitlement, the persisted debt queue became [2, 3]. Both debt branches were unselectable, so the single worker repeatedly logged no queued branch is currently selectable while branch 1 and branch 4 still represented active tournament hypotheses.
mechanism.primary_cause: r22 limited both ordinary selection and orphan-root-lock recovery to allocation_branch_ids. A seat was removed from that list immediately after paying its phase debt, so an otherwise expandable completed seat could not donate idle capacity when every debt-bearing branch was blocked.
mechanism.why_r22_was_insufficient: r22 recovered orphan locks only inside the rights queue. It did not separate phase entitlement from work-conserving donor eligibility.

required_repair.rights_queue: Keep allocation_branch_ids authoritative and unchanged until each owed branch produces its own valid successor.
required_repair.donor_queue: After all rights-bearing branches fail normal and single-worker lock-recovery selection, try a deterministic donor queue of still-active tournament branches that already paid the current phase debt.
required_repair.accounting: A donor execution must set rolled_over=true while preserving the original target branch and must not discharge its entitlement.
required_repair.multi_worker_safety: Locked donor recovery remains disabled when parallel_search_num is greater than one.
